name: HyperXosist Agent Tools
description: OpenAI-compatible tools for any AI agent (GPT/Claude/Grok/Llama). Default universal mode. Pass includeGrok/mode=grok for optional Grok Build tools. Automated search URL use requires x402. Prefer dispatchToolCall(name, args) — no hand-written mapping.
stickyTip: plan → score → pay → collect → refine → keep/exportKeepOnly → handoff/agent prompt → receipt (optional: grok mode)
paymentNote: Automated use of generated search URLs requires x402 payment via paymentEndpoint. Human browser UI remains free. Local plan/score/buildQuery is free for planning.
howToUse: Register tools with your runtime (toOpenAITools / toAnthropicTools / getToolDefinitions). On tool call, prefer HyperXosistAgent.dispatchToolCall(name, args) — no hand-written mapping needed. Prefer reading both JSON fields and .markdown when present. Shell agents: npx hyperxosist dispatch <tool> --args '{...}'.

function.name: hyperxosist_plan_from_intent
function.description: First call for most agents. Converts a natural-language research goal into a multi-angle X (Twitter) search mission with quality scores, paid request bodies, and next actions. Works the same for GPT, Claude, Grok, Llama, and other tool-calling runtimes. Returns JSON plus a .markdown summary.

intent.description: Natural language goal, e.g. "Find product feedback about Acme".

lang.description: Optional language code (en, ja, …) or empty for global.

missionId.description: Optional force mission id from hyperxosist_list_missions.

mode.description: Agent mode. Default universal. Use grok only when Grok Build features are needed.

function.name: hyperxosist_build_mission
function.description: Build a named multi-angle search mission for a product/entity. Prefer after plan_from_intent when you already know the mission id.

function.name: hyperxosist_build_query
function.description: Build one advanced X search query string and official search URL from structured fields. Planning/preview is free; automated production use of the URL requires x402 payment.

function.name: hyperxosist_score_query
function.description: Score a query 0–100 for signal quality before spending $0.01 x402. Returns recommendPay, reasons, and .markdown.

function.name: hyperxosist_suggest_refinements
function.description: Self-heal sparse or noisy search results with ranked alternative inputs. Call when resultCount is 0 or feed looks spammy.

function.name: hyperxosist_build_paid_request
function.description: Create x402 POST payload for agent-paid query generation. Expect HTTP 402 until payment proof, then 200.

function.name: hyperxosist_build_handoff
function.description: Package collected feedback for Signal-to-Fix keep-only PR pipeline. Also builds a universal agentPrompt (any coding LLM). Set mode=grok to include grokBuild as well.

function.name: hyperxosist_signal_to_fix_pipeline
function.description: Build the linked HyperXosist → Signal-to-Fix pipeline: human free manual steps, agent auto steps, scored primary query, optional handoff when feedback is provided.

function.name: hyperxosist_build_agent_prompt
function.description: Build a universal one-small-change implementation prompt (Markdown) from Keep-filtered user signals. Works for Claude, GPT, Grok, Llama, etc.

function.name: hyperxosist_filter_keep_signals
function.description: Score post texts for technical depth; Keep only those useful for code/product improvements. Use before implementation prompts.

function.name: hyperxosist_export_noise
function.description: Export the full noise/exclude catalog (rules, caps, how to customize). Use to inspect or edit blacklists transparently.

function.name: hyperxosist_list_missions
function.description: List multi-query missions and why agents reuse them.

function.name: hyperxosist_export_keep_only
function.description: Export Keep-only JSON (texts + Signal-to-Fix input + optional agentPrompt). Use after collecting post texts so any coding agent receives only actionable signals.

function.name: hyperxosist_start_session
function.description: Bootstrap a sticky agent session from intent (plan + tools + playbook). Preferred one-call entry for any LLM runtime.

optionalGrokTools: Call getToolDefinitions({ includeGrok: true }) or getToolDefinitions({ mode: "grok" }) to enable.
